title: U.S. House · Pennsylvania's 3rd District

context.text: Incumbent Dwight Evans did not run for re-election in 2026. State Representative Christopher Rabb won the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary, defeating state senator Sharif Street, Dr. Ala Stanford, and Shaun Griffith. No candidate filed for the Republican primary.

candidates.name: Christopher Rabb
candidates.ballotNote: Won the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary over Sharif Street, Ala Stanford, and Shaun Griffith.
candidates.currentRole: Pennsylvania State Representative, District 200 (since 2016; not seeking re-election to that seat)

summary.text: Christopher Rabb is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, representing District 200 in Philadelphia since December 2016. He describes himself as a Democratic Socialist and is not seeking re-election to his state House seat.

background.text: Earned a bachelor's degree from Yale University in 1992 and a master's degree from the University of Pennsylvania in 2006.
Worked as an aide to U.S. Sen. Carol Moseley Braun (D-Ill.) and as a researcher and trainer at the White House Conference on Small Business during the Clinton administration.
Taught at Temple University's Fox School of Business and Management and was a faculty member at Drexel University's LeBow College of Business.
Elected to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives in 2016 and re-elected in 2018, 2020, 2022, and 2024.

priorities.text: Says the country faces a growing "affordability crisis" and calls for universal basic income, a living wage, national grocery stores, free high-speed public transit, and free gigabit broadband.
Calls for a "Civil Climate Corps" and a just transition to 100% renewable energy as part of a strong climate agenda.
Says community safety comes from investment in housing, education, jobs and mental health care rather than "over-policing or over-prosecuting," and calls for abolishing ICE.

positions.summary: Supports Medicare for All as part of a set of universal basic guarantees.
positions.quote: Universal Basic Guarantees: Medicare for All, Housing, Food and Water, Free Transit, High-Speed Internet, Childcare, Income, Jobs

positions.summary: Supports universal childcare from birth to age 5.
positions.quote: Universal Childcare from Birth to Age 5

positions.summary: Supports universal basic income and a living wage for all workers.
positions.quote: Universal Basic Income and a Living Wage for All

positions.summary: Opposes expanded immigration enforcement and calls for abolishing ICE.
positions.quote: Abolish ICE & Dismantle Immigrant Concentration Camps

positions.summary: Supports a just transition to 100% renewable energy and a "Civil Climate Corps."
positions.quote: A Just Transition to 100% Renewable Energy

positions.summary: Lists protecting reproductive freedom among his universal healthcare guarantees.
positions.quote: Medicare For All, Protecting Reproductive Freedom

record.text: Chairs the Pennsylvania House Finance Committee's Subcommittee on Tax Modernization and Reform in the current legislative session.
Chairs the Pennsylvania House Commerce Committee's Subcommittee on Local Business in the current legislative session.
Serves on the Pennsylvania House Agriculture & Rural Affairs and Judiciary committees.

summary.text: Dennis Mahoney is running as an Independent Party candidate for Pennsylvania's 3rd Congressional District. No campaign website content, biography, or issue statements were found beyond his listing on the general-election ballot.
